outcome: Perioperative outcomes (estimated blood loss, time to ambulation, length of hospital stay)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 220 high-risk obstetric patients scheduled for elective caesarean section or other obstetric surgeries.
finding: Comprehensive pre-operative anaesthetic assessment significantly reduced composite maternal morbidity and improved perioperative outcomes, including reduced blood loss, shorter time to ambulation, and decreased length of hospital stay, compared to standard care.
